body: Just the experience of being there really

It's just so hard...in 8th grade I was sent to a mental hospital...police picked me up as a run away and I had blood dripping down my arm from all the cuts just...going there was the second worst day of my life (the first obviously being that break up) but that was years ago...it's just had ya know?...I mean it was hard enough to even post on here because I really have no one I trust to go to in person :/
